properties.description:
Not a unit test — an instrument checked against ground truth. Run `python3 tools/vocabulary_reach.py`.

IT MUST REPORT, because all three are independently known: `SUPERSEDES` as an edge type with zero edges; `GOVERNED_BY.ruling` as a property never set (added 2026-08-17, 0 of 912 edges); and `DECOMPOSES` as an edge type with zero edges despite `req:decomposition-covers-its-parent` being accepted.

IT MUST STOP REPORTING `SPECIFIES` once the 44 schema-to-interface edges are in the export — verified dead-to-live across one export on 2026-08-18.

IT MUST NOT REPORT `Verification.description`, which was unreachable until 2026-08-17 and now has both a constructor parameter and real uses — the instrument has to notice a repair, not just a defect.
properties.findings: All four checks hold. Reports SUPERSEDES, GOVERNED_BY.ruling and DECOMPOSES; stopped reporting SPECIFIES after the export; does not report Verification.description. Buckets on reflow2's own design: 18 candidates / 10 unused-but-offered / 46 says-nothing / 42 edge-vocabulary.
properties.name: The reachability instrument is validated against vocabulary already known to be dead before its new findings are believed
